# Mentoring Philosophy
I am a firm believer in the power of a dedicated mentor to bring the best out of a student more than a regiment of homogenized courses ever could. I am grateful to have had a handful of fantastic mentors myself who have dedicated uncommon amounts of their time to encouraging my dreams and training my capabilities and I am deeply indebted to them for where I am today, including the late <a href="https://lsa.umich.edu/physics/people/in-memoriam/charles-r--doering.html">Dr. Charles Doering</a> who owns the lion's share of credit for my pursuit of research today.

# Students

Most of my student's have worked with me through the <a href="https://luddy.indiana.edu/research/student-research/index.html">Undergraduate Opportunity in Computing (UROC) program</a> offered by the Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering at Indiana University.
